lines.japanese: 昨日は大変なことになったから、今日からは真面目に起きるぞう。
lines.english: Yesterday had turned into a disaster. Starting today, I was getting up properly.

lines.japanese: そう思って目覚ましを近づけてみたり、携帯電話のアラームも駆使したりしてみたが、結局のところ自分次第らしい。最初のアラームですぐに起きられた。
lines.english: With that resolve, I moved the alarm clock closer and even brought my phone alarm into play. In the end, apparently it all came down to willpower. I woke at the very first ring.

lines.japanese: 妹になにからなにまでお世話してもらうのも楽しかったけど、ダメ人間以外の何者でもないからな。
lines.english: Having my sister wait on me hand and foot had been fun, but it also reduced me to a complete deadbeat.

lines.japanese: と思いつつも、制服に着替えてからしばらくぼーっとすること１０分。朝に得られた余分な時間っていうのはなんとなくこう、無駄遣いしたくなるもんだ。
lines.english: So I told myself. Yet after changing into my uniform, I spent ten minutes staring blankly into space. Any extra time you found in the morning had a peculiar way of making you want to waste it.

lines.japanese: とか言ってると廊下を走る音が聞こえてきた。うーん、結局起こしにこさせてしまった。よし、ここは昨日までの献身的な妹に感謝を表して迎えよう。
lines.english: Just then, I heard footsteps racing down the hall. Hmm. I'd wound up making her come wake me after all. Very well. I would greet her with due gratitude for her devotion these past few days.

lines.japanese: 「おにいちゃん！　起きて！」
lines.english: “Big brother! Wake up!”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、なにをそんなに慌てているのかねお嬢さん」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha. What's got you in such a panic, young lady?”

lines.japanese: 俺はゆっくりと襖を開いてウインク一つで出迎えた。
lines.english: I slowly slid open the door and greeted her with a wink.

lines.japanese: 「昨日まではちょっぴり妹に甘えたくてわざと寝たふりをしていたのだよ。見なさい、今の俺こそが真の羽田ヨージ。今日もいい天気だ、実に穏やかで素敵な朝」
lines.english: “These past few days, I was only pretending to sleep because I wanted to be spoiled by my little sister. Behold the true Yoji Haneda! Fine weather today—a serene and splendid morning.”

lines.japanese: <8>\「じゃねえっ！」
lines.english: “Like hell it is!”

lines.japanese: 妹は毛布一枚でやってきた。
lines.english: My sister had arrived wearing nothing but a blanket.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう！　よかった、起きてた！」
lines.english: “Good morning! Thank goodness, you're awake!”

lines.japanese: 「いやもしかしたら、いま夢を見てるかも」
lines.english: “Or perhaps I'm dreaming right now.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、寝ぼけてるの？」
lines.english: “What? Are you still half asleep?”

lines.japanese: 「いや現実ならめっちゃ目が覚めたけど」
lines.english: “Well, if this is reality, I'm wide awake now.”

lines.japanese: 俺があられもない妹の姿を見ていると、なにかを勘違いしたのか両手を振って言い訳を始めた。
lines.english: As I stared at my sister's indecent state, she seemed to misunderstand why and began waving both hands in explanation.

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんねおにいちゃん、私きのうの夜、お風呂入ったあと目覚ましかけないで寝ちゃって」
lines.english: “I-I’m sorry, Big Brother. Last night, after my bath, I fell asleep without setting my alarm.”

lines.japanese: 気を引き締めた兄とは対照的に妹は気が抜けてたらしい。
lines.english: Unlike her brother, who had braced himself, my sister had apparently let her guard down.

lines.japanese: 「だから朝ごはんの支度もしてないの、ごめんっ」
lines.english: “So I haven't made breakfast either. I'm sorry!”

lines.japanese: 「朝ごはんの前にするべき支度はあると思うぞ」
lines.english: “I think there's something else you need to get ready before breakfast.”

lines.japanese: 「だからおにいちゃんを起こしにきたの！」
lines.english: “That’s why I came to wake you, Big Brother!”

lines.japanese: 「ややや、ちがうちがう、順番ちがう。お兄ちゃんより優先するべきものがあるだろう」
lines.english: “N-no, no, wrong order. There’s something that ought to come before Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 「ないよ！　おにいちゃんが一番大事！」
lines.english: “Nothing! You’re the most important to me, Big Brother!”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ぶおおおっ」
lines.english: “Bwooooh!”

lines.japanese: 俺は感動した。小鳩いい子。もうめっちゃいい妹。
lines.english: I was overcome. Kobato, what a good girl. What an amazing little sister.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう、俺はいい妹を持った。本当にありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you. I'm lucky to have such a wonderful sister. Thank you, truly.”

lines.japanese: 「え、えへへ、そんなことないよ」
lines.english: “O-oh, hee hee. I'm not that special.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩の両肩に手を置いて涙すると、小鳩は照れたように笑った。
lines.english: I placed both hands on Kobato's shoulders and wept. She gave me a bashful smile.

lines.japanese: 「でも冬なんだからちゃんと服は着ような」
lines.english: “But it is winter, so you ought to put some clothes on.”

lines.japanese: 「ふく？」
lines.english: “Clothes?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえまだ風呂あがりに裸のままうろつく癖が抜けてないんだろう」
lines.english: “You still haven't broken that childhood habit of wandering around undressed after a bath, have you?”

lines.japanese: 「な、なおったよそんなの！」
lines.english: “I-I have! I don't do that anymore!”

lines.japanese: 「でもホラ」
lines.english: “But look.”

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩の毛布を引っぱって、己の状態を視覚で確認させてやった。
lines.english: I gave Kobato's blanket a tug, forcing her to look down and see the state she was in.

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ」
lines.english: “Hwuh?”

lines.japanese: 「ふええええんっ！　おにいちゃんなんて朝ごはん抜きで食パンかじりながら曲がり角で女の子にぶつかっちゃえっ」
lines.english: “Waaaaah! Big Brother doesn’t get any breakfast! Go run out with a slice of toast in your mouth and crash into a girl at a street corner!”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、そんなことになってもお兄ちゃんちっとも困らないぞう」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha. Big Brother wouldn’t mind that one bit.”

lines.japanese: うちの妹はひとを憎めない良い子だなあ。俺はこれから支度をする彼女に代わって、朝食の準備をしてあげることにした。
lines.english: My sister was far too kind to hate anyone properly. While she got herself ready, I decided to make breakfast in her place.
